caption: The drawing depicts a round, shallow ceramic bundt pan or mold with a central cylindrical tube rising from the base. The exterior surface of the pan is light brown or tan in color with a speckled texture, while the interior appears slightly darker and smoother. Around the outside of the pan, there are several repeated decorative blue motifs, each consisting of two adjacent oval shapes with short lines or stems connecting them, resembling stylized leaves or petals. The pan sits on a plain, light beige background, and the perspective used in the drawing shows both the inside and outside of the object, highlighting its form and decorative details.
title: Baking Dish
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
